The '''Rethel''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] rumored to have existed on a [[Unidentified planet (Rethel Point)|planet]]<ref name="RE" /> in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

It was rumored that the Rethel had built a [[Unidentified city (Rethel Point)|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], at one [[Time/Legends|time]] long before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. The ruins of the [[City/Legends|city]] emanated a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] disruption field known as [[Rethel Point]]. However, the ruins were so old, with so little evidence left behind by the builders, that the idea that their name had somehow survived was hard to believe.<ref name="RE" />
